business_summary: Amicro Technology Co., Ltd. robotics technology platform engaged in offering mobile robotics solutions, including inertial navigation robotic solutions, single-modal robotic solutions and multi modal robotic solutions in China. The company offers Amicro Core design and develops of dedicated system-on-chip (SoC) semiconductors for intelligent mobile robots, leveraging proprietary robotics technologies, mixed-signal chip design capabilities, robot perception systems, intelligent algorithms, sensors, and motion-control modules, Amicro provides full-stack robotics solutions used in applications such as cleaning robots and service robots. It offers technologies Chips, Sensors, Algorithms, SDK, Toolchain. The Integrated Circuit segment offers microcontrollers, memory chips, and application-specific integrated circuits. The Sensor segment provides sensor modules, including pressure, temperature, and humidity sensors. The company also develops and supplies embedded system solutions and software for industrial, automotive, and consumer electronics applications. It serves downstream participants in the robotics ecosystem, including industry leaders in cleaning robots, service robots and companion robots. Amicro Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in China and exports its products to international markets. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Zhuhai, China.Amicro Semiconductor Co., Ltd. develops and provides high-integration semiconductor system-on-chip (SoC) solutions and power management integrated circuits for robotics, visual processing, navigation, mapping, and related applications. The company offers SoC and single-chip solutions for simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), navigation, mapping, and sensor data processing, with product lines that include AM380S, AM580, AM780, AM790, and AM890. These chips integrate multiple 32-bit CPUs, DSPs, hardware accelerators, and algorithm engines for visual processing, navigation, mapping, and sensor fusion. The company also provides power management integrated circuits for high-voltage system power supply and charging management, suitable for robots, handheld electric tools, and unmanned aerial vehicles. Software development kits and development tools are available to support rapid software development and integration, with solutions supporting multiple sensor interfaces and battery configurations. The company serves industrial clients in the robotics industry, including manufacturers of cleaning robots, handheld electric tools, unmanned aerial vehicles, and clients requiring power management and sensor integration solutions. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Zhuhai, China.
business_summary_ko: Amicro Technology Co., Ltd.는 중국에서 관성 항법 로봇 솔루션, 단일 모드 로봇 솔루션 및 다중 모드 로봇 솔루션을 포함한 모바일 로봇 솔루션을 제공하는 로봇 기술 플랫폼입니다. 이 회사는 Amicro Core 설계를 제공하고 독점 로봇 기술, 혼합 신호 칩 설계 기능, 로봇 인식 시스템, 지능형 알고리즘, 센서 및 동작 제어 모듈을 활용하여 지능형 모바일 로봇을 위한 전용 SoC(시스템 온 칩) 반도체를 개발합니다. Amicro는 청소 로봇 및 서비스 로봇과 같은 응용 분야에 사용되는 풀 스택 로봇 솔루션을 제공합니다. 칩, 센서, 알고리즘, SDK, 툴체인 기술을 제공합니다. 집적 회로 부문은 마이크로컨트롤러, 메모리 칩 및 애플리케이션별 집적 회로를 제공합니다. 센서 부문은 압력, 온도 및 습도 센서를 포함한 센서 모듈을 제공합니다. 또한 이 회사는 산업, 자동차, 가전제품 애플리케이션을 위한 임베디드 시스템 솔루션과 소프트웨어를 개발하고 공급합니다. 청소 로봇, 서비스 로봇 및 컴퓨터 분야의 업계 리더를 포함하여 로봇 생태계의 다운스트림 참여자에게 서비스를 제공합니다.
